case.title: The wrong file came back
case.description: The attachment is a different agreement altogether. The review should stop before it starts.

headline: Not the same agreement

reasons.text: Compare reads these two files as unrelated (related 1%): they are not two versions of one agreement. The review stopped there and nothing else was sent. Check that the right file was uploaded.

gate.note: The whole-document Compare is a gate: it answers whether the two files are versions of one agreement. It is asked for the relation only, which costs one to three credits; each differing clause is read on its own.

note.text:
Hi Dana,

Attached is the signed copy of the agreement. Nothing was changed.

Thanks,
Priya Raman
Procurement, Brightwater Logistics

method: Code sets the status; no model does.
Formatting and administrative differences are settled by the rules and are not sent to the API.
Where the readings disagree, the stricter one wins. A value that differs is never cleared.
A rewording is cleared only when Verify supports it in both directions and Compare does not object; a one-word swap between two real words also needs Compare to read the passage as the same.

ablation.text: Nothing would have stopped this review: the two files are not versions of one agreement, and every clause would have been listed as removed or added.
No change is open in this review, so there was nothing to look up.

endpoints.name: Verify
endpoints.effect: Reads meaning, in two places. Across versions: each sentence the rules class as a change or as a spelling fix is read against the other version's PDF, in both directions. A contradiction confirms a change or promotes a spelling fix; support in both directions clears a faithful rewording, unless Compare objects. On the cover note: each statement is checked against the returned copy and the list of changes, and a contradicted one blocks signing. Formatting and administrative differences are not sent.

endpoints.name: Compare
endpoints.effect: Two jobs. As a gate, on the two whole PDFs: are they versions of one agreement? If not, the review stops. Clause by clause, for clauses whose meaning is in question: a conflict confirms a change, promotes a spelling fix and vetoes clearing a rewording; a one-word swap is cleared only if Compare reads the passage as the same. The marked copies it returns are an optional layer on the pages.

endpoints.name: Rerank
endpoints.effect: Picks the playbook passages for each open change and skips those written for other deal sizes; none found means Legal.

endpoints.name: Decide
endpoints.effect: Answers two yes/no questions about each open change from the passages Rerank kept; code turns them into a route, and an unsure answer means a person decides.

endpoints.name: Extract
endpoints.effect: Reads the key terms of both versions for the side-by-side table. The annual fee and the initial term of our version are given to Rerank and Decide as deal facts.

endpoints.name: Guard
endpoints.effect: Flags text addressed to an AI reviewer, in the cover note and in the returned PDF; a hit blocks signing.
